Parking commitment: PR opens DRAFT; `needs:contract-review` goes on both carriers in the same stroke the PR exists; review chain owns enqueue.

Claim amendment (same seat, session `session_01PBjwYLS6BciTQW3c9xQiD2`, branch `claude/issue-6594-headercolor-mirror-narrow`) — one file added to the declared surface, so the list parallel seats serialize on stays accurate.

Added: `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.headerColor.test.tsx`.

Why it is not scope creep: the narrowing turned three of its existing assertions into compile errors, because they author off-vocabulary values on purpose to prove RENDERER behaviour — `tsc` named them at (87,44) `bg-accent`, (100,44) `not-a-token`, (117,44) `constructor`. Leaving them red is not an option and reverting the narrowing defeats the card, so this is fallout of this change rather than a stray repair. All three tests stay; they now route their value through one documented `offContract()` seam that records why the value is off-contract and forbids widening the declaration to make them compile without it. Each was re-judged individually — none is a misspelling of a live token, none pins a branch this change removes.

Still untouched and still read-only for this seat: `packages/plugin-detail/src/headerColor.ts`. The new pin imports its exported vocabulary; it was mutated only inside an ablation that proves its own restore (disk hash equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty).

`packages/types` surface is unchanged from the original claim — `views.ts` and `zod/views.zod.ts` only, no barrel edit and no barrel export added, so the disjointness from the in-flight domain:ui batch holds.

- **Diff spot-checks**: both halves carry exactly the six ruled tokens; the pin compares all three ends against the RULING as a fixed oracle rather than pairwise — a coordinated edit moving every end together still goes red — and the comparator itself has a recognition suite (shown to fail, not only to pass); the `bg-*` pass-through is pinned as the ruled asymmetry (resolver accepts, both contract halves refuse, `@ts-expect-error` becomes an unused directive if anyone later declares it).
- **Premise/parity measurement**: NO FORK — installed `@objectstack/spec@17.2.0` carries zero `headerColor` occurrences (positive controls hit), and no objectui gate binds this mirror to the installed spec; the claim's stop-condition never fired.
- **Census before tightening**: `headerColor` appears in no authored metadata anywhere in the tracked tree (positive controls prove the probe reached `examples/`/`apps/` etc.) — no migration owed, so the accept-set narrowing strands nothing.
- **Gates**: 192 files / 1946 tests green across both packages; type-check proven to MEASURE the new pins (`--listFiles` + rebuilt dist grep); ablations A/B/C predicted-red observed-red with on-disk mutation proof and HEAD-blob hash restores (leg B's first zero-hit substitution self-caught and re-run — no reading taken on an unmutated tree); changeset gates green; three prerequisite-not-met gates declared honestly (unbuilt workspace, CI owns them).
- **Changeset**: `@object-ui/types: minor` against the named precedent #5853, with the structural departure (no exported tuple) argued in the changeset itself.
- **Out-of-scope finding** #6955 (registry input still offers free text for the now-closed vocabulary — the value-level twin of the designer-key parity class) — correct routing, left ungraded for triage.
